findings.issue: The 200 ms search debounce timer is never cancelled when the home component unmounts; typing then clicking a card or pagination link within the window fires applyFilters after navigation and redirects the user back to /?q=…
findings.suggestion: Clear the timer in a useTask$ cleanup (or on route-start), so pending input can't navigate after leaving the page

findings.issue: Module-level cache Map is unbounded with no eviction; acceptable only because the API dataset is fixed
findings.suggestion: Add a simple size cap or note the assumption (fixed ~2k distinct URLs) in the module comment

findings.issue: Cold-cache fan-out: a pokemon page awaits ~100-180 parallel find(move/…) requests plus version-group and type fetches before rendering
findings.suggestion: Acceptable with the in-memory dedupe, but consider limiting concurrency or pre-warming the move cache to bound burst load

findings.issue: Three signals mirror the loader (members/coverage/relations) via a copy task, creating a second source of truth
findings.suggestion: Keep one members signal and derive coverage with useComputed$(members, () => coverageRows(members.value, relations.value))

findings.issue: TeamMemberData stores the same types array twice (card.types and member.types)
findings.suggestion: Drop the top-level types and have coverageRows read member.card.types, or vice versa

findings.issue: One module holds the data builders for all seven pages; it is sectioned and cohesive now, but growth will concentrate edits in one file
findings.suggestion: Split per-route builders into lib/pages/<name>.ts later; keep the shared helpers where they are

findings.issue: No custom error route; if the PokeAPI is unreachable, Qwik's stock unbranded 500 page is shown
findings.suggestion: Add a routes error boundary or wrap get() failures to render a themed error page

findings.issue: undici is an unused devDependency (and engines still allows Node 18 while the spec targets Node 24)
findings.suggestion: Drop undici and refresh the engines field

findings.issue: Single !important used to pad the stat-total row
findings.suggestion: Give the total row its own class instead of overriding the shared selector

summary: A genuinely idiomatic Qwik City app on the current stable release: route loaders, URL-as-state, cookie-backed SSR state for the team feature and clean server/client boundaries all match the docs. The only real defect is a small debounce race that can hijack navigation; everything else is nits. I'd merge after the timer fix.
